title: NetEase launches AI-generated open world 'Infinite Realm', built by team of 40 in 18 months
content: NetEase has released Infinite Realm (无限领域), an open-world action RPG developed by a core team of 40 people over 18 months, enabled primarily through AI-assisted content generation. The game's 200km² open world was generated using NetEase's proprietary NeWorld AI pipeline, which automates terrain sculpting, asset placement, and NPC behavioral scripting. Voice acting for over 2,000 NPCs was entirely synthesized. NetEase stated this represents a '10x reduction in per-content-unit cost' compared to traditional pipelines. The title launched on iOS and Android in China with 8 million pre-registrations, positioning AI-generated content as a competitive production strategy rather than an experimental one.
